GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.

Contents
This handbook is a quick reference to Gleuhr's background, key policies, guidelines and workplace expectations, to ensure a professional, respectful and productive environment for all employees. For any clarification, contact the HR Department at hr@gleuhr.com.

1. Company Introduction & History
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
1.1 About the Company
Gleuhr is an award-winning, clinic-backed skin, hair, aesthetics and nutrition brand that combines professional clinic services with its own science-led skincare and wellness product range. The company focuses on improving skin health, hair health and overall well-being through personalised consultations, science-backed treatments and diet support.
Founded in 2019 with its first clinic in Sector 17, Chandigarh, Gleuhr was built on the belief that internal health and external beauty are deeply connected. Today the company has served more than 2,50,000 patients across its growing clinic network.
1.2 Founders & Leadership
Mr. Urminder Singh – Managing Director & Co-founder: With a background in nutrition science, he has grown Gleuhr from a single clinic into a multi-clinic enterprise, introducing technology and streamlined processes across the network.
Dt. Gagan Sidhu – Chief Dietician & Co-founder: An award-winning dietitian with over a decade of experience, she shapes Gleuhr's client-centred, science-backed approach and leads a predominantly women-led team.
1.3 Our Founding Story
The founders saw many people struggle with pigmentation, acne and premature ageing, trying product after product without lasting results. They realised the real gap was a deeper understanding of Indian skin, climate, lifestyle and nutrition. This led to Gleuhr: a doctor-led skin and aesthetic clinic backed by advanced technology, personalised skin assessments and a result-oriented approach.

2. Vision, Mission & Core Values
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
2.1 Our Vision
To become the leading global brand that redefines beauty and wellness by merging clinical expertise with a holistic approach, building a community where people achieve balanced health, radiant beauty and confidence, inside and out.
Gleuhr believes beauty and wellness are inseparable. The company aims to set a new standard in the industry, inspire people to choose long-term wellness over temporary solutions, and continue to grow while staying true to holistic and sustainable beauty.
2.2 Our Mission
To empower individuals with a holistic approach to beauty and wellness, offering scientifically advanced products, personalised treatments and integrated diet plans that deliver real, long-lasting results.
2.3 Our Core Values
1.	Holistic Wellness: We combine outer care with inner health, supporting treatments with diet, stress and lifestyle guidance.
2.	Scientific Integrity: We use clinically tested ingredients, advanced technology and evidence-based methods to provide safe and effective care.
3.	Integrity & Trust: We communicate honestly and ethically, set clear expectations and recommend only what is in the client's best interest.
4.	Knowledge: We educate clients so they can make informed skincare and wellness choices.
5.	Personalised Care: We tailor every treatment plan to the individual's needs.
6.	Long-Term Results: We focus on sustainable results rather than quick fixes.
2.4 Our Approach to Care
Holistic by Design: Clinical treatments combined with diet and topical support.
Fully Personalised: Every plan is built around the individual – no one-size-fits-all solutions.
Clinically Proven & Safe: Science-backed, steroid-free and non-invasive treatments.
Dedicated Support Teams: Guiding clients at every step towards visible, lasting results.
2.5 What Our Values Mean for Employees
Understand each client's concerns before recommending any treatment or product.
Share accurate information and avoid false promises or unsupported claims.
Follow approved clinical protocols and company guidelines.
Put the client's long-term well-being ahead of short-term sales.

3.2 Our Services
Skin & Aesthetics: pigmentation, acne and scars, anti-ageing, laser and skin-glow treatments, medicated facials, Hydrafacial, under-eye care, Botox, threads and fillers, double chin and slimming.
Hair: hair-fall treatment, GFC + PRP, meso hair therapy, medicated hair spa and dandruff care.
Diet & Nutrition: personalised diet plans, weight management, PCOS, thyroid and diabetes nutrition, skin-health nutrition and lifestyle coaching.
3.3 The Client Journey
1.	Consult – a free consultation to assess the client's skin needs and goals.
2.	Treat – a customised treatment plan targeting the specific concern.
3.	Glow – visible improvement in skin texture and radiance, supported by follow-ups and home care.
3.4 Our Product Line
Gleuhr's science-led product range supports in-clinic results at home. Categories: Skincare, Haircare, Herbal Teas, Makeup and Nutrition. Products are available at our clinics and on gleuhr.com.

3.5 Employee Guidelines
Give clients accurate information about services and products.
Recommend products only as advised by the doctor or consultant.
Never make medical or result claims beyond approved product information.
4. Organisation Structure & Key Contacts

4.2 Reporting Structure
Every employee reports to one reporting manager, who is the first point of contact for work-related matters. Matters move up the structure as follows:
1.	Reporting Manager / Branch Manager – day-to-day work, leave approval and first-level concerns
2.	HR Department – attendance, leave policy, salary, payroll and employee grievances

5. Clinic / Office Tour
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
On the first day, every new employee is given a guided tour of the clinic or office by HR, the reporting manager or an assigned buddy, so they know their workplace, facilities and safety procedures.
5.1 Areas Covered
Reception and client waiting area
Consultation rooms
Treatment and laser rooms

Attendance point
5.2 Safety & Hygiene
Location of fire exits, fire extinguishers and the first-aid kit.
Treatment rooms, laser rooms and stock rooms may be entered only when authorised.
Follow clinic hygiene and sanitisation protocols at all times.
Report any unsafe condition or equipment fault to the branch manager immediately.
5.3 Day-One Checklist
Clinic / office tour completed
Workstation and assets handed over
Attendance registration completed
Introduced to reporting manager and team
Handbook received
6. HRMS Login & Attendance Process
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
Accurate attendance records are the basis for salary processing. Every employee must follow the attendance process explained by HR at the time of joining.
6.1 Getting Started
1.	On your joining day, HR registers you for attendance and shares any login details you need.
2.	Check that your personal details, bank details and reporting manager are correctly recorded with HR.
3.	Change any password given to you and keep it private.
6.2 Attendance Recording
Mark your attendance every working day, on arrival and when leaving, at your assigned clinic or office.
Attendance records are the basis for salary calculation, so they must be accurate and complete.
6.3 Reporting Time & Working Hours
Report to work by the start time of your assigned department timing or shift (see Section 9).
Complete 9 working hours per day, subject to the applicable shift and break policy.
Late arrivals are governed by the grace-period rules in Section 9.
6.4 Attendance Discrepancies
1.	If you miss marking attendance or notice an error in your record, email your reporting manager and HR (hr@gleuhr.com) on the same day.
2.	Mention the date, your actual in and out time, and the reason.
3.	Your reporting manager confirms the details, and HR corrects the record.
6.5 Leave & Payslips
Leave is applied by email to your reporting manager (see Section 9).
Salary, PF, reimbursement and payslip queries are handled by HR (hr@gleuhr.com).
6.6 Important
Never share your login or password – passwords are confidential company information.
Report any attendance or login issue to HR at hr@gleuhr.com promptly.
7. Meet the Team
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
Gleuhr believes in teamwork. In the first week, every new employee is introduced to the people they will work with, so communication and collaboration start smoothly.
7.1 Your First Week
Day 1: Meet HR and your reporting manager; clinic / office tour.
Days 2–3: Meet your team and other departments you will work with.
Days 4–6: Shadow a senior colleague; learn services, products and processes.
7.2 Your Buddy
A buddy is assigned to help you settle in, answer everyday questions and guide you through your first weeks.

8. Code of Conduct
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
This Code of Conduct outlines the professional and ethical standards expected from every employee of Gleuhr Wellness Pvt. Ltd., to foster a respectful, productive and trustworthy work environment.
8.1 Professional Behaviour
Maintain integrity, honesty and fairness in all business dealings.
Respect company policies, clients, vendors and fellow employees.
Ensure punctuality and regular attendance.
8.2 Workplace Conduct
Avoid any form of discrimination, harassment, spreading rumours, gossip or offensive behaviour.
Treat all team members and stakeholders with dignity and respect.
Maintain a clean and safe work environment.
Dress decently and professionally as per the company dress code.
8.3 Confidentiality & Company Property
Do not disclose internal information or company secrets to unauthorised parties.
Use company assets, including digital devices, only for official purposes.
Damage, theft or misuse of company property will lead to disciplinary action.
8.4 Conflict of Interest
Avoid any activity that may conflict with the company's interest.
Disclose any outside work, financial interest or personal relationship that may influence your decisions.
8.5 Disciplinary Measures
Violation of this Code may lead to disciplinary action, including suspension, termination or legal action, depending on the severity of the breach.

9.3 Leave
How to request leave:
1.	Email your reporting manager before taking leave, mentioning the dates and reason.
2.	Take leave only after your reporting manager approves it.
3.	For sudden or sick leave, email your reporting manager before your shift start time on the same day.
4.	For extended leave or exceptional approval, contact Ms. Harman, HR Head (hr@gleuhr.com).
Leave entitlement and its bifurcation are as communicated to you at the time of joining.
Short leave: employees may take 2 short leaves per month, of up to 2 hours each, with prior approval from the reporting manager.
Absence without approval is treated as leave without pay and may lead to disciplinary action.
All violations are reviewed by management and action is taken based on severity and frequency. The company reserves the right to modify this policy as per business requirements.
10. Dress Code & Grooming
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
As a skin and wellness brand, our appearance is the first thing clients notice. Every employee must maintain a clean, neat and professional appearance as per the company dress code and workplace standards.
10.1 Branch-Specific Dress Code
The applicable dress code may vary by branch.
Contact your Branch Manager for the dress code requirements of your branch.
Where a company-provided coat is issued to Branch Managers and Counsellors, it must be worn during working hours and kept clean.
Wear your name badge where provided.
10.2 Professional Appearance
Maintain a professional appearance at the workplace at all times.
Avoid torn clothing, shorts, slippers or clothing with offensive slogans.
Wear clean, closed footwear; keep hair neat and tied back in treatment areas.
10.3 Grooming & Hygiene (All Staff)
Maintain personal hygiene at all times.
Keep nails short and clean; keep jewellery minimal.
Use light or no fragrance – many clients have sensitive skin.
Follow hygiene and safety standards that apply to your role.
11. POSH Policy (Prevention of Sexual Harassment)
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
Gleuhr Wellness Pvt. Ltd. is committed to keeping the workplace safe, respectful and free from sexual harassment, in line with The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013. Every employee, regardless of gender, caste, religion or background, should feel valued and supported.
11.1 Who This Policy Covers
All employees – permanent, temporary, contract staff and interns.
Visitors to the workplace – clients, customers, suppliers and contractors.
11.2 What Counts as Sexual Harassment
Unwanted physical contact or advances.
Asking for sexual favours.
Sexual remarks or jokes.
Showing sexual content or gestures.
Any other sexual behaviour that makes someone feel unsafe or uncomfortable.
11.3 How to Report a Complaint
If you face or witness sexual harassment, report it to Ms. Harman, HR Head (hr@gleuhr.com) in person, by phone or in writing.
11.4 How Complaints Are Handled
1.	Report Received – the complaint is registered.
2.	Investigation – the complainant, accused and any witnesses are heard.
3.	Decision & Action – if proven, action such as warning, suspension or termination is recommended.
4.	Follow-up – checks are made to ensure there is no retaliation or further problem.
11.5 Confidentiality & Training
All complaints are kept confidential and shared only with those directly involved in resolving the case.
Regular training covers this policy, gender sensitivity, caste and religion sensitivity, and a safe, respectful workplace.
The policy is reviewed regularly to follow the law and meet workplace needs.
12. Data Privacy & Confidentiality
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
Every employee must protect the proprietary and sensitive information they receive during their employment with Gleuhr Wellness Pvt. Ltd.
12.1 What Is Confidential Information
Business strategies, financial data, client information, marketing plans and pricing models.
Technical processes, operational workflows, vendor agreements and proprietary materials.
Employee information, training material, internal communication and any data not publicly available.
12.2 Employee Obligations
Do not disclose, share or misuse confidential information.
Do not copy, email, photograph or store confidential information, including passwords, outside company systems unless authorised.
Use such information only to perform your job.
Do not establish personal relationships with clients, contact them on personal phone numbers or communicate outside official channels.
Never accept gifts, money or favours from clients in any form.
12.3 Salary Confidentiality
Your salary, compensation structure and benefits are confidential. Sharing salary information with colleagues, outsiders or on public platforms without written management consent is strictly prohibited.
12.4 Return of Information & Breach
On leaving the company or on request, return or destroy all confidential material and confirm that no copies are kept.
Any breach may lead to disciplinary action, including termination and legal proceedings.
13. Salary, PF & Payroll Process
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
13.1 Joining Documents
Employees must submit accurate details for payroll: bank account, PAN, Aadhaar and UAN (if any). Any change must be informed to HR immediately.
13.2 Monthly Payroll Process
1.	Salary is calculated from your monthly attendance records.
2.	Late-arrival, half-day and leave-without-pay deductions are applied as per the attendance policy.
3.	Monthly salary is expected to be credited to your bank account by the 7th of each month.
4.	Payments for extra working days are expected to be processed by the 15th, subject to payroll processing and applicable rules.
13.3 Statutory Benefits
Provident Fund (PF): PF is governed by the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 and its applicable rules. Where PF applies, the employee contributes the prescribed percentage of PF wages, and the company also contributes as prescribed. Part of the employer's contribution goes to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS), so the employer amount credited to your PF account may differ from your own contribution.
Employee State Insurance (ESI): ESI applies only to employees who meet the applicable statutory wage limits and eligibility requirements.
For PF, ESI, salary deduction or statutory benefit queries, contact HR (hr@gleuhr.com).
13.4 Queries & Confidentiality
For any salary, payroll, deduction or payment-related query, contact the HR Department (hr@gleuhr.com).
Salary details are confidential and must not be discussed with colleagues.
14. IT & Asset Usage Policy
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
14.1 Custody & Responsibility
All IT equipment and assets issued to employees remain the property of the company.
You are fully responsible for the safekeeping, proper use and maintenance of any company property assigned to you – laptop, phone, tablet, devices or equipment.
Use company property only for official purposes, unless prior written permission is given for personal use.
Keep property in good working condition; do not tamper with, lend or misuse it.
14.2 IT Security
Protect your login credentials and lock your screen when away.
Do not install unapproved software or connect unknown devices.
Use company email and systems only for business purposes.
14.3 Loss or Damage
Inform your reporting manager, IT or HR immediately in case of loss, theft or damage.
The company will evaluate any negligence or misuse.
If caused by carelessness, negligence or intentional misuse, the cost of repair or replacement may be deducted from salary or final settlement, and disciplinary or legal action may be taken.
14.4 Return of Property
All company-issued assets must be returned in proper condition when an employee leaves the company (on resignation, termination or completion of service) or whenever requested by the company. Failure to do so may result in withholding of dues or further action.
14.5 IT Support
For IT assistance, technical issues and company asset-related queries, contact Aryan or Inder (IT Department).
15. Client / Patient Handling Etiquette
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
Every client trusts Gleuhr with their skin and health. Each interaction must reflect our values of honesty, personalised care and respect.
15.1 Welcoming the Client
Greet every client warmly and address them respectfully.
Offer a seat and keep waiting time short; inform them of any delay.
Speak in the language the client is comfortable with – Hindi, Punjabi or English.
15.2 During Consultation & Treatment
Listen fully to the client's concern before advising.
Explain treatments, number of sessions and costs clearly – no false promises or guaranteed results.
Only doctors and authorised consultants give medical advice.
Take written consent before any treatment and before taking any photograph.
Protect privacy – discuss concerns in the consultation room, not at the front desk.
15.3 Professional Boundaries
Communicate and follow up only through official clinic numbers and channels.
Do not build personal relationships with clients or accept gifts, money or favours.
Keep all client records and photos confidential.
15.4 Handling Complaints
Stay calm and polite; listen without interrupting.
Apologise for the inconvenience and escalate to the branch manager.
Escalate clinical concerns to the doctor or Medical Head immediately.
16. Communication & Email Etiquette
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
All workplace communication must be clear, respectful and professional.
16.1 Email
Use a clear subject line and a polite greeting.
Keep the message short and to the point; use a proper signature.
Copy (CC) only those who need the information.
Reply to work emails within one working day, even if only to acknowledge.
16.2 Phone
Answer with: Good morning, Gleuhr [clinic name], [your name] speaking. How may I help you?
Speak politely and clearly; note down client details accurately.
16.3 WhatsApp & Chat Groups
Use official groups only for work.
No forwards, jokes or personal content in work groups.
Never share client details or confidential information on personal chats.
16.4 General Rules
Use official channels for all business matters.
Avoid gossip and maintain a respectful tone at all times.
Do not post company or client information on social media.
17. Conflict Handling
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
Disagreements can happen in any workplace. At Gleuhr, they must be handled calmly, respectfully and without affecting client service.
17.1 Steps to Resolve a Conflict
1.	Talk directly – discuss the issue privately and respectfully with the person concerned.
2.	Reporting manager – if unresolved, raise it with your reporting manager.
3.	HR – if still unresolved, HR will mediate and record the outcome.
4.	Ms. Harman, HR Head – serious cases and escalations are referred to the HR Head.
5.	Management – matters requiring management intervention are escalated through the appropriate management channel.
17.2 Principles
Never argue in front of clients.
Focus on the issue, not the person.
Listen to understand, not to blame.
Sensitive complaints, such as harassment, go directly to Ms. Harman, HR Head.

19. Workplace Discipline & Punctuality
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT. LTD.
19.1 Expectations
Report to work on time and be ready to work by your assigned start time (see Section 9).
Complete assigned responsibilities and follow lawful instructions from management.
Avoid personal phone use on the clinic floor or in front of clients.
Take breaks only at scheduled times; keep your workstation clean.
Follow all company policies, clinical protocols and hygiene standards.
19.2 Disciplinary Steps
1.	Verbal warning
2.	Written warning
3.	Salary deduction or suspension
4.	Termination
19.3 Serious Misconduct
The following may lead to immediate termination and legal action:
Theft, fraud or intentional damage to company property.
Sexual harassment or abusive behaviour.
Leaking confidential, client or salary information.
Accepting gifts, money or favours from clients.

Policy Administration
Gleuhr Wellness Pvt. Ltd. may review, modify or add to its policies at any time as per business requirements and applicable laws. Employees will be informed of material changes through appropriate channels. Where a company policy conflicts with applicable law, the law will prevail.
